<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917153_theRebbe_141" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917153_theRebbe_141__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the possibility of a Jew being considered a Canaanite slave arises only from the soul's descent, but the inherited hidden love from Avraham ensures he remains a Canaanite slave of a Hebrew, and the purpose of this descent is to ultimately reveal his true Hebrew essence through Torah study.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, this that it is possible to have a logical premise in the Torah that "Or it could be that he is only the slave of a Hebrew," but he himself is a Canaanite slave,</t>
    <t s="2">meaning that the level of service should be in the aspect of a Canaanite slave, for whom "abandonment is pleasing,"</t>
    <t s="3">is only from the descent of the soul below,</t>
    <t s="4">that it descended from a high roof to a deep pit.</t>
    <t s="5">[And even then, there is no logical premise that he would be a completely Canaanite slave, G-d forbid, but rather "his slave</t>
    <t s="6">(Canaanite)</t>
    <t s="7">of a Hebrew,"</t>
    <t s="8">for the influence and mastery of the "Hebrew" is upon him,</t>
    <t s="9">because even one who is on the lowest level among Israel</t>
    <t s="10">(in the aspect of a Canaanite slave,</t>
    <t s="11">due to the descent of the soul below)</t>
    <t s="12">nevertheless, because he is a child of Avraham our father</t>
    <t s="13">[for Avraham was one,</t>
    <t s="14">Avraham the Hebrew]</t>
    <t s="15">he has as an inheritance the love</t>
    <t s="16">(and fear)</t>
    <t s="17">that is hidden, as explained at length in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="18">that this love and fear of G-d acts upon each and every one</t>
    <t s="19">(even if it seems to him that abandonment is pleasing to him,</t>
    <t s="20">that his desire is for other matters,</t>
    <t s="21">even for matters that are the opposite of what is desired, G-d forbid)</t>
    <t s="22">that he must do as the Most High wants,</t>
    <t s="23">and therefore it is impossible that he be a complete Canaanite, G-d forbid, but only a Canaanite slave of a Hebrew,</t>
    <t s="24">that in a revealed way he is in the aspect of a Canaanite slave,</t>
    <t s="25">but within him is found</t>
    <t s="26">(in concealment)</t>
    <t s="27">the hidden love inherited from Avraham the Hebrew].</t>
    <t s="28">And the intent of this descent,</t>
    <t s="29">that there is a logical premise in the Torah that "Or it could be that he is only the slave of a Hebrew,"</t>
    <t s="30">is only so that through his service in "the teaching says" – the study of Torah in a manner that he learns from it what is the will of the Torah – behold, he will immediately see and reveal his true self, that "here too, he is a slave who is a Hebrew,"</t>
    <t s="31">and that he himself is a Hebrew</t>
    <t s="32">(and not that he is a Canaanite and only the mastery of the Hebrew is upon him),</t>
    <t s="33">meaning that his place and level is in the aspect of "the other side of the river,"</t>
    <t s="34">and also as it is brought in the Midrash</t>
    <t s="35">that what Avraham is called Avraham the Hebrew is because the entire world is on one side and he is on the other side,</t>
    <t s="36">and so he acts in his service to be</t>
    <t s="37">(a slave)</t>
    <t s="38">a Hebrew,</t>
    <t s="39">that he stands himself against the entire world,</t>
    <t s="40">beginning from the concealment and hiding</t>
    <t s="41">(world from the term concealment)</t>
    <t s="42">of his animal soul,</t>
    <t s="43">and transforms it,</t>
    <t s="44">and goes and ascends from level to level,</t>
    <t s="45">from the aspect of a Canaanite slave</t>
    <t s="46">(that you took from Israel)</t>
    <t s="47">to the aspect of a slave</t>
    <t s="48">(who is)</t>
    <t s="49">a Hebrew,</t>
    <t s="50">and afterwards also to the aspect of a Hebrew maidservant,</t>
    <t s="51">until he acts through his service that he, or his son, will betroth her,</t>
    <t s="52">as explained at length in the esteemed discourse of our great master, of blessed memory, mentioned above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the entire concept of the Canaanite slave, Hebrew slave, and Hebrew maidservant applies to the daily service of every Jew, where descent into worldly matters is only for the sake of an ascent that leads to even greater service.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, the entirety of the above matter also exists in the service of each and every person every day.</t>
    <t s="2">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="3">that the aspect of a Canaanite slave is when Israel is in a state of being clothed in worldly matters in order to</t>
    <t s="4">refine them,</t>
    <t s="5">and as it is written,</t>
    <t s="6">"And you shall do all your work,"</t>
    <t s="7">that there must be work in matters of this physical world and also in the materiality of the world in order to transform it into holiness,</t>
    <t s="8">that from this clothing in worldly matters,</t>
    <t s="9">through the refinement, it is possible that an undesirable matter from the thing being refined will cling to the one who refines, as is brought in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="10">and through this it is possible that at the beginning of the service he will appear as in the aspect of a Canaanite slave.</t>
    <t s="11">However, this descent is for the purpose of an ascent,</t>
    <t s="12">and therefore it is only for a moment,</t>
    <t s="13">and immediately afterwards is the beginning of the ascent,</t>
    <t s="14">and moreover, through the descent an ascent is made with greater excellence and greater strength,</t>
    <t s="15">in the manner explained in Tanya</t>
    <t s="16">regarding the matter that confuses a person in his prayer,</t>
    <t s="17">that from the confusion itself he must be aroused to pray with more intention from the depths of the heart.</t>
    <t s="18">And it is when he contemplates that since the Holy One, blessed be He, is the one who gives life to the matter that confuses him, behold, surely this that was shown to him</t>
    <t s="19">(from above)</t>
    <t s="20">this confusion,</t>
    <t s="21">and the confusion is found within his domain of knowledge,</t>
    <t s="22">and even confuses him in his prayer,</t>
    <t s="23">it is</t>
    <t s="24">(not because it is a matter in itself, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="25">but rather)</t>
    <t s="26">only so that the person, through his service, will make from the confusion delicacies for the Many,</t>
    <t s="27">first through the service in the aspect of subjugation</t>
    <t s="28">(the entirety of the service of the intermediate ones),</t>
    <t s="29">until he also reaches the aspect of transformation</t>
    <t s="30">(the entirety of the service of the righteous)</t>
    <t s="31">as explained in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="32">and likewise is the matter in the above, that from the descent itself he must be aroused with greater excellence to perform his service in the aspect of a Canaanite slave,</t>
    <t s="33">a Hebrew slave and a Hebrew maidservant,</t>
    <t s="34">until he reaches the state of having "he, or his son, will betroth her,"</t>
    <t s="35">and until "she shall go out free, without payment"</t>
    <t s="36">[for all this is the entirety of the service of subjugation and transformation mentioned above]</t>
    <t s="37">as explained at length in the aforementioned discourse.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section concludes that through the six years of service, one reaches the seventh year of freedom, which alludes to the ultimate perfection of the future era when G-dliness will be revealed below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through the aforementioned service of "six years he shall serve,"</t>
    <t s="1">that</t>
    <t s="2">("he shall serve")</t>
    <t s="3">refers to the entirety of man's service to his Master,</t>
    <t s="4">behold, they arrive at "and in the seventh"</t>
    <t s="5">("he shall go out free, without payment"),</t>
    <t s="6">which refers to the most sublime perfection that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="7">the day</t>
    <t s="8">that is entirely Shabbat and rest for the life of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="9">for then there will be a revelation of G-dliness below,</t>
    <t s="10">a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms</t>
    <t s="11">[and a foretaste of this revelation also shines now on Shabbat,</t>
    <t s="12">and especially</t>
    <t s="13">in the time of the "desire of all desires"].</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
